Each pair of brackets takes the colour of its nesting depth.
Use the toggle at the top right to see the dark-theme colours.

## Math

$$
f(g(h(x))) + [0, 1) + \left( \frac{1}{2} \left[ a + \{b\} \right] \right)
$$

Inline math works too: $(a + (b + (c + (d + (e)))))$.
The fifth level starts the colours again.

An author's own colour wins: ${\color{red} (x)}$.

## Code

```racket
(define (sum-list lst)
  (if (empty? lst)
      0
      (+ (first lst) (sum-list (rest lst))))) ; "(not this)"
```

```r
mean(sapply(list(a = c(1, 2), b = c(3, 4)), function(v) sum(v[v > 1])))
# (comments keep their colour)
```

```python
print(sorted({k: len(v) for k, v in [("a", [1, 2]), ("b", [3])]}.items()))
s = "(strings keep theirs)"
```
